name: Legislation of Kosovo, as enacted (Official Gazette, gzk.rks-gov.net)
label: Kosovo: laws as enacted
record_note: every act in the Official Gazette's list of laws (LawInForceList: laws, codes, Constitutional Court judgments, in force or repealed) plus the 2008 Constitution and its amendments, each as enacted, dated by its own in-force article; amendments are not applied (listed in data/amendments.csv); repealed acts' files are deleted on the repealing act's in-force day; English translations under en/; acts in force after the build day are on the future branch

dates.commit: in-force (from the act's own in-force article)

scope.when_absent: no scope note extracted for Kosovo; transitional provisions are in each act

default_reach.rule: no retroactive criminal liability or heavier penalty
default_reach.meaning: no one may be charged or punished for an act that was not a criminal offence under law when committed, and penalties follow the law in force at the time unless a later law is more favourable; no general rule for other laws was checked here
default_reach.authority: Constitution of the Republic of Kosovo (2008), art. 33(1) and (4)

citation.note: Albanian forms "neni N", "nenit N", "nenin N"; citations are within the same act; the English files (en/.../article-NNN.md) are not matched by the file rule
